title: Ultimate skills
text: Ultimate skills have ten modes each: change mode with the mode key, press to use. The five Veldanava skills (Sandalphon, Israfil, Jibril, Solomon, Hercules) are given by an admin with /veldanava. Nen (Hunter x Hunter) has Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Ken, Ko, Vow, En, Gyo plus Shu, In, Ryu and the six Hatsu types; each Hatsu works best on your own Water Divination type. All Fiction has ten modes. Gate of Babylon (Fate) and Ki (Dragon Ball) are the newest pair.
